description: Get the latest e/acc items for a 24-hour or 7-day briefing. Prefer selected mode unless the user explicitly asks for every public item. Do not use this for named-topic search or multi-source event context.

category.description: Optional category: ai-models, ai-products, industry, paper, tip, opinion.

lang.description: Stored edition language. Defaults to English. Missing editions return edition_unavailable; no live model calls.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, from 1 to 30.

mode.description: selected returns editorial picks; all returns every public item.

window.description: Time window. Use 24h for a current briefing and 7d for a weekly view.

name: eacc_get_latest
